crew.overview: In this chilling and groundbreaking documentary, former Indonesian death squad leaders reenact their real-life mass killings in the style of various film genres, from gangster epics to musicals. As they recreate their past atrocities, the line between reality and performance blurs, exposing the lingering impact of Indonesia’s 1965-66 anti-communist purge and the unsettling psychology of its perpetrators.
crew.title: The Act of Killing

details.biography: Mariko has worked on BAFTA and academy award nominated films such as Joshua Oppenheimer’s The Act of Killing and The Look of Silence, and Shiori Ito’s Black Box Diaries.  She also worked on Lisa Rovner’s Sisters with Transistors, Marcus Werner Hed’s The R&B Feeling, and Others Like Me, and on artists’s films such as Maeve Brennan’s Listening in the Dark, Manu Luksch’s Dreams Rewired, The Otolith Group’s infinity minus infinity, and Robin Meier’s Synchronicity.
details.name: Mariko Montpetit
